verdict.rationale: llama.cpp ships a first-party terminal CLI: `llama cli -hf <model>` pulls and runs a model, and the README shows a VLM 'session with `llama cli`'. A community user confirms interactive chat use in the terminal CLI, loading images via '/image image.png' in chat. missing for 10: in-depth first-party documentation of interactive chat-mode features (chat templates, conversation controls, slash commands), and independent corroboration of the plain-text `llama cli` chat flow specifically rather than the multimodal variant.

support.subject: As a developer, I can start an interactive chat session with a model directly from the terminal

citations.quote: loading images via '/image image.png' in chat
